about: Rolex Paris Masters 2026, main draw Mon 2 – Sun 8 Nov, La Défense Arena (Paris time; CET from 25 Oct). Martino decided 1 Nov: the game starts from the SECOND round (R32 → F); the first round (R64, 24 matches, the 8 top seeds have a bye) is not scored and is kept in opening_round, so its losers show as out while squads are open. This replaces the 20 Oct decision (all six rounds), taken too late to launch before Monday's first ball. Every time is an early floor: pin each from the order of play the evening before. 2 Nov: checked against the official schedule (29 Oct): R64 Mon 2 + Tue 3 (9 of 24 on Tuesday), R32 Tue 3 + Wed 4, R16 Thu, QF Fri, SF Sat, F Sun 15:00. Every round after R32 is played in one day, so each market window is a clean overnight gap. QF and SF moved to the day's first ball.
